everythingWarning.withOthers: Deletes 1 MB. Every game compiles its shaders again. Games SCSKiller compiled stutter until you compile them again, and the rest build their cache as you play. The other apps and games group (1 MB) is included: apps and games outside SCSKiller build their caches again too.
everythingWarning.withoutOthers: Deletes 0 MB. Every game compiles its shaders again. Games SCSKiller compiled stutter until you compile them again, and the rest build their cache as you play. The other apps and games group (1 MB) is kept unless you tick it.

groups.title: Other apps and games
groups.caption: Desktop apps, and games SCSKiller hasn't compiled or seen running. A game moves to its group once SCSKiller sees it running.
groups.consequence: These apps and games build their cache again as they run, and may stutter until they have. Files in use are skipped.
